description: Retrieve one Try catalog entry by its id, e.g. law. Read-only; returns the entry's name, price, notes, and links. Use when you know the exact entry id; use box_search to find an id by keyword. An unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

id.description: Entry id within the Try catalog, e.g. law. Get the id list from box_search with an empty query; an unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

name: box_get
